// fixture: clean-adapter. Fictional family Asha; not compiled, read by test/media-ast-scan.test.ts as text.
// as: apps/mobile/src/lib/media/asset-record.ts
// expect: none
export type PixelSize = { readonly width: number; readonly height: number };
export type AssetRecord = {
  readonly opaqueId: string;
  readonly capturedAt: string | null;
  readonly kind: 'photo' | 'video';
  readonly durationMs: number | null;
  readonly pixelSize: PixelSize | null;
  readonly cityKey: string | null;
};
export function toAssetRecord(raw: Record<string, unknown>): AssetRecord | null {
  const id = raw.id;
  if (typeof id !== 'string' || id === '') return null;
  const width = Number(raw.width);
  const height = Number(raw.height);
  return {
    opaqueId: id,
    capturedAt: typeof raw.takenAt === 'string' ? raw.takenAt : null,
    kind: raw.mediaType === 'video' ? 'video' : 'photo',
    durationMs: null,
    pixelSize: width > 0 && height > 0 ? { width, height } : null,
    cityKey: typeof raw.cityKey === 'string' ? raw.cityKey : null,
  };
}
